repositories.name: gstack
repositories.type: Agent skill framework for Claude Code
repositories.primary_focus: Specialized agent roles + persistent browser + release workflows

patterns.name: Skill-Based Architecture
patterns.description: Organize agents as specialized roles (CEO, eng manager, designer, QA, release engineer)
patterns.integration_notes: One-shot already has architect/implementer/reviewer; expand to 7 total roles

patterns.name: Persistent Browser Daemon
patterns.description: Long-lived Chromium process with sub-100ms latency via localhost HTTP
patterns.integration_notes: Useful for web-based scaffolds; not blocking for MVP

patterns.name: Safety Skills Pattern
patterns.description: /careful, /freeze, /guard commands for destructive operation protection
patterns.integration_notes: Aligns with zone-based approval gates

patterns.name: Structured Review Workflows
patterns.description: Plan-mode reviews (CEO, eng, design, DX) before implementation phase
patterns.integration_notes: Streaming spec + user review gate (see Phase 2)

patterns.name: Template Generation from .tmpl
patterns.description: Auto-generate SKILL.md files from templates with host-specific rendering
patterns.integration_notes: Reduces duplication across skill definitions

patterns.name: Release Workflow Pipeline
patterns.description: Coordinated ship → deploy → verify → monitor with PR awareness
patterns.integration_notes: Useful for multi-stage generation workflows

repositories.name: lean-ctx
repositories.primary_focus: Persistent MCP server, policy engine, knowledge consolidation, code intelligence

patterns.name: Persistent MCP Server Architecture
patterns.description: Run MCP server as daemon with shared state (session, knowledge, tools)
patterns.integration_notes: Enables shared curriculum across tool invocations; phased rollout

patterns.name: Policy Engine with Profiles
patterns.description: Centralized governance for roles, budgets, autonomy drivers, memory lifecycle
patterns.integration_notes: Extends zone approval to fine-grained control (dev/ci/audit profiles)

patterns.name: Knowledge Store with Semantic Embedding
patterns.description: Fact-based memory with embedding-based search + category consolidation
patterns.integration_notes: Move beyond curriculum (failures) to proactive knowledge (success patterns)

patterns.name: Intent-Based Routing
patterns.description: Classify user intent from request and route to appropriate agents automatically
patterns.integration_notes: Reduces need for explicit agent selection; improves UX

patterns.name: Property Graph for Code Intelligence
patterns.description: 232+ edge types: calls, imports, defines, inherits, etc. + graph queries
patterns.integration_notes: Improves domain model extraction; tree-sitter integration needed

patterns.name: Context Compression Pipeline
patterns.description: 56 shell patterns + entropy filtering + multi-tokenizer support
patterns.integration_notes: Useful for large projects; not blocking for MVP

repositories.name: awesome-ai-apps
repositories.type: Pattern library + recipe collection for LLM apps
repositories.primary_focus: MCP agents, memory patterns, agent orchestration, RAG

patterns.name: MCP Agent Patterns
patterns.description: MCP-backed agents with tool discovery and dynamic registration
patterns.integration_notes: Directly applicable to plugin's MCP integration strategy

patterns.name: Memory Agent Architecture
patterns.description: Episodic, procedural, prospective memory with consolidation
patterns.integration_notes: Extends curriculum tracking; complements knowledge store pattern

patterns.name: Advanced Agent Orchestration
patterns.description: Parallel execution, tree-of-thought, chain-of-thought patterns
patterns.integration_notes: Parallel architect + implementer + test-author (Phase 2)

patterns.name: RAG Application Patterns
patterns.description: Semantic search + vector store integration for context retrieval
patterns.integration_notes: Useful for project context enrichment; not blocking

patterns.name: Fine-tuning Agent Patterns
patterns.description: Model-specific prompt optimization and evaluation
patterns.integration_notes: Useful for cost/quality tuning; requires empirical data

patterns.name: Voice Agent Integration
patterns.description: Multi-modal input handling with streaming output
patterns.integration_notes: Out of scope for code generation; future exploration

repositories.name: karpathy-repos
repositories.primary_focus: Minimal reproducible examples, educational scaffolding, progressive complexity

patterns.name: Minimal Reproducible Examples
patterns.description: Single-file implementations with clear data flow (nanoGPT, llm.c style)
patterns.integration_notes: Excellent starting points for scaffold templates; use for reference

patterns.name: Progressive Complexity Layers
patterns.description: Build up from basics (char-level) to complex (multi-head attention)
patterns.integration_notes: Mirrors curriculum design in one-shot; educational value for users

patterns.name: Educational Code Scaffolding
patterns.description: Clear, well-commented implementations for learning
patterns.integration_notes: Add comments explaining architecture decisions to generated code

quick_wins.name: Safety Skills Pattern
quick_wins.why_quick: Low complexity; aligns with zone approval

quick_wins.name: Minimal Reproducible Examples
quick_wins.description: Use Karpathy-style templates as scaffold starting points

quick_wins.name: Cost Report Command
quick_wins.why_quick: Builds on ledger infrastructure; <1h per stat

anti_patterns.name: One Agent Does Everything
anti_patterns.why_bad: Monolithic agents are hard to test and extend
anti_patterns.recommendation: Adopt specialist roles (architect, implementer, reviewer, designer, etc.)

anti_patterns.name: Cold-Start Per Request
anti_patterns.why_bad: Context lost between calls; 3-5 sec latency per generation
anti_patterns.recommendation: Keep MCP daemon alive; share state across calls

anti_patterns.name: Fail-Silently on Budget Exceeded
anti_patterns.recommendation: Always alert; offer degradation (templates, smaller models)

anti_patterns.name: No Intent Understanding
anti_patterns.why_bad: Forces explicit agent specification; poor UX
anti_patterns.recommendation: Infer intent from request; support override

anti_patterns.name: Linear Sequential Execution
anti_patterns.recommendation: Run architect + implementer + tests in parallel

anti_patterns.name: Curriculum Without Decay
anti_patterns.why_bad: Old failures remain relevant forever; bloat
anti_patterns.recommendation: Apply decay curves; consolidate facts over time

backwards_compatibility.migration_path: All new features opt-in; defaults preserve current behavior
backwards_compatibility.adoption_strategy: Gradual; encourage adoption via docs + examples
